description:
Submit the user's answers to the questions from zebra_get_rc2_questions, all at once.

On success, a licensed agent at agency_phone finishes buying the policy with the user. Present
agency_call_message verbatim or nearly so: it says whether the agency is open now or when it opens. Never tell
the user to call now when it says the agency is closed, and never promise a voicemail or a callback.
When continue_url is returned, also offer it: the user can finish online with an agent during agency hours.
If it fails with an agency_phone, this quote can't be bought in chat right now. Call again if retryable is true.
Otherwise, or if it keeps failing, give the user agency_phone and the agency hours to finish with a licensed
agent, or offer them another quote from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

answers.description: Every answer, including the current_values the user kept, keyed by field_key (each part of a grouped question under its child_field_keys key). Answer a CHECKBOX question with a list of the chosen values, even when only one is chosen: ["Yes"], not "Yes".

quote_handle.description: The quote_handle that zebra_start_session returned. It expires 24 hours after zebra_start_session; if a tool reports it unknown or expired, start a new session.

name: zebra_submit_rc2_answers

agency_call_message.description: What to tell the user next: whether the agency is open now or when it opens, the phone number, and the agency hours. Present it verbatim or nearly so.

agency_phone.description: The licensed agency the user calls to finish buying the policy.

continue_url.description: Where the user can finish online with a licensed agent, by chat or over the phone, during agency hours.

title: Submit answers to the carrier
